name: SymfonyLive Paris 2027
description: French-language Symfony conference with two pre-conference training days
note: on-site; talks in French; trainings 23-24 Mar; 399 EUR excl. VAT until 20 Jan 2027, then 499 EUR; CFP open
details:
SymfonyLive Paris is the French edition of the official Symfony conference series by SymfonyCorp: two conference days on 25-26 March 2027, with two pre-conference training days on 23-24 March.

Prices excl. VAT: conference 399 EUR until 20 January 2027, 499 EUR until 17 February, 549 EUR last minute, 599 EUR on site; trainings 990 EUR, conference + training from 1,111 EUR. The early-bird price (349 EUR) ended 30 September 2026. The venue is not announced yet ("nous finalisons l'emplacement"); a call for speakers page is open.
